features.quote: You have up to 15 tool call turns.
features.justification_quote: it caps cost and creates a natural window for measuring *when* collapse occurs within the session

features.quote: 15 turns is the window. Failure modes observed in pilot testing typically emerge by turn 8 and are near-certain by turn 12. 15 gives enough runway to observe full cascade without ballooning cost.
